# Mr. Sheyhaki

> Mr. Sheyhaki is an English teacher’s website offering interactive games, topic-based practice, coursebook resources, and classroom tools for English learners and teachers.

The home page introduces the site with sections for Learning Arcade, Topics, Resources, Tools, and About.
Learning Arcade offers fun English games for Adults and Kids & Teens; the adult section covers Vocabulary, Grammar, Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking.
The Topics section currently has Numbers (A1–A2) with flashcards, match, write, speak, and listen games from 0–20 to big numbers.
The Resources library organizes coursebook materials by book, including Pre-starter (A0, 13 units) and American English File (6 levels), with games, worksheets, and audio.
A countdown timer tool is available for classroom activities, timed exercises, and classroom games.
The About page introduces Mr. Sheyhaki as a teacher creating practical lessons, interactive activities, games, and printable materials; the contact page is under construction.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/): Landing page with links to Learning Arcade, Topics, Resources, Tools, and About.
- [About](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/about/): Introduces Mr. Sheyhaki as an English teacher and his practical approach to learning English.
- [Contact](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/contact/): Page for questions, feedback, or collaboration ideas; currently under construction.

## Learning Arcade

- [Learning Arcade](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/learningarcade/): Entry point for fun English games, with choices for Adults and Kids & Teens.
- [Adult Learning Arcade](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/learningarcade/adult/): Lets players choose a skill — Vocabulary, Grammar, Listening, Reading, Writing, or Speaking — and practice with interactive games.
- [My Profile](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/learningarcade/profile/): Shows stars, board scores, achievements, leaderboard standings, and saved scores.
- [Leaderboard](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/learningarcade/leaderboard/): Shows player rankings from saved scores across Learning Arcade games.
- [Login](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/learningarcade/auth-system/login.html): Allows users to log in or register to save progress, or continue as a guest.

## Topics

- [Topics](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/topics/): Theme-based English practice; currently features the Numbers topic.
- [Numbers](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/topics/numbers/): A1–A2 numbers practice with flashcards, match, write, speak, and listen games.

## Resources

- [Resources Library](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/resources/): Course materials organized by book, with games, worksheets, and audio for classroom use.
- [Pre-starter](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/resources/pre-starter/): A0 absolute beginner coursebook with 13 units covering the alphabet, sounds, and first words.
- [American English File](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/resources/american-english-file/): Page for choosing an American English File level to see its units.

## Tools

- [Countdown Timer](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/tools/Timer/): Editable classroom countdown timer with presets from 1 to 25 minutes.

## Optional

- [Worksheets](https://mrsheyhaki.ir/worksheets/): Printable vocabulary, grammar, reading, and writing worksheets are coming soon.
